title: Spleen Collection from Mice and Determination of Spleen Index
author: Amandine Even
materials: The spleen is weighed with a precision scale.

steps.title: Weigh the mouse
steps.instruction: Weigh the mouse to obtain the body mass required for calculating the spleen index.

steps.title: Extract the spleen
steps.instruction: Extract the spleen from the mouse using forceps and scissors after appropriate euthanasia.

substeps.instruction: If perfusion is required, harvest the spleen after anesthesia and before trans-cardic perfusion.
Ensure only the dark spleen is harvested, avoiding yellow fat or white conjonctive tissues.

steps.title: Calculate the spleen index
steps.instruction: Calculate the spleen index using the formula: spleen mass (mg) / mouse body mass (g).

steps.title: Prepare spleen for further analysis
steps.instruction: If performing further analyses such as flow cytometry, quickly transfer the spleen to a tube containing cold 1X PBS solution for subsequent splenocyte isolation.
